Georgia Institute of Technology is a public research university seeking a Web Developer to develop, test, implement, and maintain web-based applications within a campus unit. The role involves troubleshooting website issues, supporting unit web needs, maintaining documentation, and reporting application status.
Higher Education
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Confer with unit management regarding web application content requirements and status
Conduct web based application development and implementation consistent with unit needs
Maintain assigned applications providing resolution of issues in a timely manner
Respond to specialized needs of the unit relative to its website(s)
Maintain required documentation related to unit web applications
Prepare and present status reports regarding web applications
Perform other duties as assigned
Qualification
Web Application Development
Web Application Configuration and Deployment
Database Design
Drupal
WordPress
WCAG 2.1/2.2 Level AA
Google Analytics 4
Adobe Photoshop
Version Control
Quality Assurance and Testing
Search Engine Optimization
UI/UX Design
Required
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and work experience
One to two years of job related experience
This job requires working knowledge and skills in configuration and deployment of web applications including database design, web base scripting languages and web standards. Additionally, skills in presentation, customer service and problem solving are required
Demonstrated experience developing, maintaining, and managing websites using a content management system (CMS), preferably Drupal and/or WordPress
Working knowledge of web accessibility standards and best practices, including WCAG 2.1 Level AA, with the ability to identify and remediate common accessibility issues
Experience using Google Analytics (GA4) or similar web analytics platforms, with the ability to interpret website data, identify user behavior and trends, and translate findings into recommendations for content, navigation, and website improvements
Proficiency with Adobe Photoshop or comparable image-editing software, including resizing, cropping, optimizing, and preparing images and graphics for web use
Experience with version control, web documentation, quality assurance/testing, and development workflows
Understanding of SEO and web performance best practices, including page structure, metadata, search discoverability, image optimization, and site performance
Experience with UI/UX design principles, including user-centered design, information architecture, navigation, wireframing, and usability
Formal training, certification, or demonstrated advanced experience in digital accessibility, including WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA compliance and accessibility testing/remediation
Experience conducting usability testing, accessibility audits, or user-experience assessments and implementing improvements based on findings
Experience working in higher education, government, nonprofit, or another complex organization with multiple stakeholders and content owners
Experience supporting websites within an institutional brand/design system and maintaining visual and content consistency across web properties
Experience using Google Analytics and other data sources to make evidence-based recommendations for website strategy, content organization, and user engagement
Preferred
Additional Preferred Qualifications 
  
Systems and job environment will house specific software applications and operating systems that are associated with additional specific skills that are preferred
